_comment: Canonical taxonomy for the TODO system. The generator (.claude/scripts/gen-todos.mjs) reads this to validate every docs/todos/*.md frontmatter and to order the generated docs/TODO.md index. The /todo skill and humans consult it. To add a milestone/area/priority, edit here. Customize the areas + milestones to your project (the /define-product and /define-architect skills can help).

milestones.label: Pre-release — before the v1.0 launch cut

_statusNote: open/in-progress/blocked/deferred live in docs/todos/. done/cancelled are archived to docs/todos/completed/.
